text:
Rickard Rakell's season has a trade story hanging over it: the headlines this week include a report that Pittsburgh is fielding calls on him. You can see why teams would ask. He has 6 goals in his last ten games, all of his goals this season, on almost exactly what his chances deserve (6.3 expected). Nothing about the finishing looks lucky.

The assists are the thin part, 4 in 18 games, and his overall scoring rate sits below the range we'd expect from him. That gap usually closes for a player on the Crosby and Malkin line who plays almost 20 minutes a night. Evolving-Hockey had his competition in the 97th percentile last season, so he is not getting soft matchups.

At 33, he projects to about 59 points over a full season, wherever he plays it. For a contender looking for a right shot who can take hard minutes and finish around the net, that is a useful rental. For the Penguins, he is the kind of player whose value peaks right around now.
headline: Rakell is scoring while the phone rings
